name: Hadal-Barrow

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond acid rain regions the sky stays the color of a bruise.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in iron and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
